topic: Myth: Entrepreneurship is too risky for a teenager
caption:
The best time to take a small business risk? When you have nothing to lose.
Your teen can test an idea, earn real money, and learn what works, all before the pressure of adult life kicks in.
Failure at 15 is a lesson. The same lesson at 35 is a crisis.
Give them a head start → hustleup.us
